fields.name: Item
fields.evidence: serializers bg3.exe+0x8FC860 / 0x8FCA00 / 0x8FC5D0 / 0x8FC7A0: two raw 16-byte members at +0 and +0x10. EoCClient.dll+0xE24CD0 ecl::inventory::SoundSystem::ProcessInventoryEvents takes the component (stride 0x20) as a Guid*, maps +0 and +0x10 through the uuid->handle map to two entities and queues them for the add-to-inventory sound. Live: a different Guid in every instance (the item that was added).

fields.name: field_10
fields.evidence: second Guid, also resolved to an entity in ProcessInventoryEvents. Live: only 2 distinct values over 13 instances (owner/inventory side: player character or its inventory).

open_questions: Which of the two Guids is the item and which the inventory/owner is inferred from live variety only.
